wireframe-icons: New in 8b: the picker's Icons view, a grid of the icon set under its search. The base has no picker.
wireframe-phone-pieces: New in 8b: at 600 px the strip's Pieces opens the picker above the bottom bar, full width less 20 px, six cells to a row. The base shows the strip with no Pieces button.
wireframe-pieces: New in 8b: Pieces opens the picker 12 px right of the Sign in screen, with Basics led by Box and Text and each piece drawn small. The bar folds to the screen's side of it, down to Pieces, ··· and Delete. The base has no picker.
wireframe-screen: Changed in 8b: the selected screen's bar shows Pieces straight after the Screen label, which moves the bar's other buttons right.
